buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the

original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. This document is to be read in conjunction with the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), Speci al Terms and Conditions (STC) and the companion document (Technical Specifications) uploaded with this bid. 2. Scope of Work. 2.1. The scope includes supply, delivery at the consignee location, installation, integration, testing , commissioning and training for the complete system in the Schedule of Requirements. The seller sh all be responsible for the following :- 2.1.1. A Mounting bracket/ adaptor shall be supplied with each cameras to attach it to the pole, mast or other structure indicated by the Buyer. 2.1.2 . The Seller shall also supply a Tripod mounting stand of Ht minimum 4 Feet alon g with the camera which is adaptable with the mounting Brackets and the camera being su pplied. 2.1.3. Laying of the optical fibre cable, splicing, termination and OTDR testing of each link, with test reports submitted to the Buyer. 2.1.4. Integration of each camera with its NVR and display and demonstration of live view, PTZ control and playback. 2.2. Mount with the Camera to attach it with the requisite structure indicated by buyer. 3. Technical Compliance. 3.1. Bidders shall upload an item-wise Technical Compliance Statement against the Technical Spe cifications along with the OEM datasheets / brochures. 3.2. A mere statement of "Complied" without supporting OEM documents shall not be accepted. 4. Eligibility and Bidder Declarations.

4.1. The bidder shall upload a self-declaration that it :- 4.1.1. Is not insolvent, in receivership, bankrupt or being wound up, and its business a ctivities have not been suspended. 4.1.2. Has not been convicted, and none of its directors / officers has been convicted, of any criminal offence related to professional conduct or to obtaining a procurement cont ract within the last three years. 4.1.3. Is not debarred, suspended or blacklisted by any Ministry / Department of Gove rnment of India, State Government or PSU on the date of bid submission. 4.1.4. Is not an allied firm of, and has no common ownership or management with, an y other firm bidding in this tender. 4.1.5. Does not employ, and has not engaged as consultant, any retired Gazetted Of ficer of the Government within one year of retirement without prior Government permissio n. 4.2. Firms registered as DPIIT-recognised Startups shall be given relaxation in prior turnover and experience as per GeM provisions selected in the bid. 5. OEM Authorisation and Conflict of Interest. 5.1. If the bidder is not the OEM, an OEM Authorisation (MAF) specific to this bid for the camera (It em 1) shall be submitted, confirming the OEM's support for warranty, spares and service for the peri od specified. 5.2. An OEM may authorise only one dealer for this bid. The OEM and its authorised dealer shall n ot both bid; in such a case, the bids of both shall be rejected. 5.3. Quoting of pool rates, cartel formation, bid rigging or collusive bidding is prohibited. Such bid s shall be rejected and action, including reporting to the Competition Commission of India and debar ment, shall be initiated. 6. Make in India. 6.1. The procurement shall be governed by the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, as revised in 2024 and as amended from time to time. Only Class-I and Class-II Local Supplier s shall be eligible, as selected in the GeM bid. 6.2. Bidders shall upload a self-certificate of local content indicating the percentage and the locati on(s) of value addition, and the cost of imported items.

6.3. Imported items sourced through resellers, and rebranded imports, shall not be counted as loc al content. 6.4. The bidder shall declare that it is not from a country that restricts Indian suppliers in its own government procurement (reciprocal-country declaration), as required under the Order. 6.5. A false declaration shall lead to rejection of the bid / cancellation of contract, forfeiture of EM D / PBG and debarment as per the Order and GeM GTC. 7. Restriction on Bidders from Countries Sharing Land Border. 7.1. Provisions of Rule 144(xi) of GFR 2017 and the Department of Expenditure Order No. 6/18/20 19-PPD dated 23 Jul 2020 (as amended) shall apply. 7.2. The restriction shall also apply to a bidder having a Transfer of Technology (ToT) arrangemen t with an entity from such a country. 7.3. The successful bidder shall not subcontract any part of the work to a firm from such a countr y unless that firm is registered with the Competent Authority. 7.4. The bidder shall submit the prescribed certificate. 8. Security of Equipment and Data. 8.1. In view of the security-sensitive nature of the deployment, the bidder shall declare the countr y of origin of the camera, NVR and their key components (image sensor, SoC / chipset and firmware). 8.2. The bidder / OEM shall give an undertaking that the hardware, firmware and software are free of any malware, backdoor, hidden remote access or data-transmission feature. 8.3. The system shall operate on a closed / isolated network. Cloud, P2P and remote access featur es shall be disabled. No data shall be transmitted outside the Buyer's network. 8.4. All recorded video and data shall be the sole property of the Buyer. Faulty HDDs shall not be taken away by the seller; they shall be retained or destroyed by the Buyer. 8.5. Default passwords shall be changed at commissioning and handed over to the Buyer. 8.6. The OEM shall share design details, and source code or access to it, for security audit by the user's designated or CERT-In empanelled agency, if so required by the Buyer.

8.7. The bidder / OEM shall give an undertaking that there are no export-control restrictions in the country of origin on the supplied equipment, and that no foreign end-use verification or network aud it shall be required. 8.8. The bidder / OEM shall give an undertaking that it is not involved in, or under investigation fo r, any malpractice. 9. Technical Evaluation and Field Trials. 9.1. Technically compliant bidders shall demonstrate the offered camera (Item 1) in field trials at Menchuka, Arunachal Pradesh on a date notified by the Buyer, at no cost to the Buyer. The bidder sh all make the equipment available within 10 days of notice. 9.2. Trials shall be conducted by a Board of Officers as per a Trial Directive / Acceptance Test Pro cedure (ATP) shared with all qualified bidders. Parameters tested shall include day detection range ( vehicle at 12 km), night detection range (vehicle at 5 km, human at 2 km), PTZ performance, video analytics and image quality. The Hybrid Wind-Solar power generator set along with UPSinverter will be tested for desired outputs and Power Backup as mentioned in Technical Specifications. 9.3. The equipment brought for trials shall be of the same make, model and configuration as offer ed in the bid. Failure to report for trials, or failure in any mandatory parameter, shall result in rejecti on of the bid. Only one opportunity shall be given, unless the failure is attributable to the Buyer or w eather. 9.4. All costs of transportation, operators, insurance and any damage to the bidder's equipment d uring trials shall be borne by the bidder. 9.5. Financial bids shall be opened only after for desired outputs and power backup as mentioned in Tech Specs are approved by Competent Financial Authority based on trial report. 10. Delivery Period. Supply, installation and commissioning shall be completed within 30 days from the date of the GeM contract. 11. Site Access and Personnel. 11.1. Personnel deputed for installation shall carry valid identity documents and shall comply with security instructions of the Buyer. Details of personnel shall be furnished in advance for clearance. 11.2. Photography or recording of the sites is not permitted without written permission. 11.3. The seller and its personnel shall maintain confidentiality of all information relating to the site s and installation.

12. Inspection and Acceptance. 12.1. Acceptance shall be carried out by a Board of Officers detailed by the Buyer at the consignee location, and shall include :- 12.1.1. Physical verification of quantity, model and serial numbers against the contract. 12.1.2. Verification of the technical parameters against the Technical Specifications, inc luding a field demonstration of day and night detection ranges. 12.1.3. Verification of backup duration of the power system and of recording duration o f the NVR. 12.1.4. Fiber link test (OTDR / power meter) reports. 12.2. CRAC on GeM shall be issued only after successful installation, commissioning and acceptanc e. 13. Warranty. 13.1. All items shall carry a comprehensive on-site warranty of two years from the date of successf ul commissioning and acceptance, covering all parts, labour, travel and replacement. 13.2. Any item which cannot be repaired shall be replaced with a new item of the same or higher s pecification. 14. Service Support. 14.1. During warranty the seller shall attend to complaints within 48 hours and restore the system within 14 days of reporting. If repair takes longer, a standby unit shall be provided. 14.2. The seller shall provide a service contact (phone / e-mail) and escalation matrix. 15. Spares and Product Support. 15.1. The seller / OEM shall ensure availability of spares and service support for not less than five y ears after expiry of warranty, and for the life of the equipment as far as practicable.

15.2. The OEM shall intimate the Buyer at least 12 months in advance before discontinuing produc tion of any item or major component, so that the Buyer may procure spares. 16. Training. 16.1. On-site hands-on training shall be provided to not less than 10 personnel of the Buyer on ope ration, routine maintenance and first-line fault rectification. 16.2. Operator and maintenance manuals in English (and Hindi, if available), in hard and soft copy, shall be supplied with each set. 17. Firmware Updates. Firmware / software updates and security patches released by the OEM during the warranty period shall be provided and installed free of cost, after approval of the Buyer. 18. Financial Conditions. 18.1. EMD. ₹9 Lakh / 3% of estimated value, as selected in the GeM bid. Exemption as per GeM GTC for eligible MSEs and Startups. 18.2. Performance Security. The successful seller shall submit an ePBG of 5% of the contract value, valid for a period of 60 days beyond the warranty period and extended until all claims are sett led. The ePBG shall be verified with the issuing bank before acceptance. 18.3. Payment Terms. Payment shall be made as per GeM GTC after successful installation, co mmissioning, acceptance and generation of CRAC. 18.4. Liquidated Damages. Delay in supply, installation and commissioning shall attract liqui dated damages as per GeM GTC, at 0.5% of the value of delayed stores per week or part thereof, su bject to a maximum of 5% (up to 10% in case of inordinate delay). 18.5. Tolerance / Option Clause. The Buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the q uantity by up to 25% at the contracted rate, as per the option clause of GeM GTC. 19. Claims. 19.1. Claims for shortages, defects or non-conformity with specifications in quantity or quality shall be raised by the Buyer within 45 days of acceptance / joint receipt inspection, in the prescribed form at (DPMF 18). 19.2. Warranty claims shall be raised within 45 days of the expiry of the warranty period for defect s noticed during the warranty, in the prescribed format (DPMF 19).

19.3. The seller shall settle the claim within 45 days of its receipt, failing which the claim shall be d eemed accepted and its value may be recovered from the ePBG or any amount due to the seller. 20. Packing and Transit. 20.1. Equipment shall be packed suitably to withstand transportation over rough terrain. The cost of transportation shall be borne by the seller. 20.2. Transit risk and insurance up to delivery at the consignee location shall be borne by the seller . 21. Documents to be Submitted at Delivery. The seller shall hand over the following at delivery :- 21.1 Warranty certificates and OEM test certificates. 21.2. Serial number list. 21.3. OTDR / link test reports. 21.4. As-installed network diagram. 21.5. User manuals. 21.6. List of passwords (in sealed cover). 22. False Declaration. Any false certificate or declaration at any stage, including on local content, co untry of origin or freedom from malicious code, shall lead to rejection of the bid / cancellation of the contra ct, forfeiture of EMD / ePBG and action for debarment as per GeM GTC and applicable rules. 23. Clarifications. Bidders may seek clarification on, or raise representationsagainst, the bid conditions or the rejection of their bid through the GeM representation mechanism within the stipulated ti me. 24. Documents to be Uploaded by Bidder (Checklist). The following shall be uploaded with the bi d. These documents shall also be listed in the GeM bid under "documents required from seller":- 24.1. Item-wise Technical Compliance Statement with OEM datasheets / brochures.

24.2. OEM Authorisation (MAF), if the bidder is not the OEM. 24.3. Make in India local content self-certificate and reciprocal-country declaration. 24.4. Land-border-country certificate (GFR Rule 144(xi)). 24.5. Declarations on eligibility (insolvency, convictions, debarment, allied firms, cooling-off) and no-malpractice undertaking. 24.6. Undertaking of freedom from malware, backdoor and hidden remote access, and the export- control / end-use undertaking. 24.7. Undertaking for spares and product support for the period specified. 24.8. Bill of Materials with country of origin of critical sub-systems. 24.9. The bidder should provide DPIIT (Department for promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) c ertificate. 24.10. Product support undertaking 7 years and service centre details. 24.11. No Chinese Component Certificate. 24.12. Certificate for Acceptance of Technical Specification. 25. Precedence. In case of any conflict between this ATC and the GeM GTC / STC, the provisions as app licable under GeM policy shall prevail. .
